title: Page Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for custom parameter pages, covering page ownership, parameter and ParGroup lists, parameter-creation methods, vector/color helper constructors, menu setup, ordering, and replace semantics.
guidance: Use this article when generating custom parameter pages rather than editing parameter JSON by hand.
Page methods create parameter groups and return a ParGroup, so generated code should capture that group before editing individual Par attributes.
Use vector and color helpers such as appendXYZ(), appendWH(), appendRGB(), and appendRGBA() when the UI should use standard TouchDesigner component naming.
After appendMenu() or appendStrMenu(), set actual choices through Par menuNames and menuLabels.
The replace argument defaults to replacing a parameter with fresh attributes; set replace=False when duplicate creation should fail loudly.
